title: PSUSA/00010386/202410: periodic safety update report single assessment for colecalciferol, colecalciferol / calcium, ergocalciferol, ergocalciferol / calcium
authors: European Medicines Agency, Pharmacovigilance Risk Assessment Committee
journal: European Medicines Agency; first published 11 June 2025; list of nationally authorised medicinal products EMA/198277/2025
result: The EU single assessment of periodic safety update reports for nationally authorised colecalciferol and ergocalciferol products, alone or with calcium, is listed with the regulatory outcome 'Maintenance'; the page gives no summary of the safety topics assessed or of any change to product information.
